methodology: Read every actual question, full supplied history, full answer and returned citations. Compared factual claims and material applicability conditions against previously inspected current official catalog/service/admissions pages, downloaded official policies and visually checked cohort tables. Re-read registration-guide and overload-procedure passages for this review. Assessed answer utility and actual claim-source support, not route names, FAQ metadata or automated scores. Incremental read-only review began during capture; final artifact is bound to completed immutable run SHA. Source-version and private-access limits remain as documented in content-source-review.md.
